summary: Postinstall lifecycle hook in package matching well-known scope lookalike
details: Package name '@solana-labs/ancor' resembles the official '@solana-labs' organization scope and could be a name-confusion lookalike against '@coral-xyz/anchor' (formerly '@project-serum/anchor'). The package declares a postinstall lifecycle hook (`"postinstall": "node install.js"`) in package.json, which would auto-execute on `npm install`. The contents and behavior of install.js were not verified in this record, so the actual install-time behavior is unknown. Lifecycle execution combined with a scope-confusion shape warrants human review before publishing a verdict.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
